origin.description: Path of the site Makevars file.
origin.details: R_MAKEVARS_SITE when set, otherwise <R>/etc/Makevars.site. An empty result is character(0) when the file is missing.
origin.example: f <- tempfile(); writeLines("X=1", f); Sys.setenv(R_MAKEVARS_SITE=f); makevars_site()

translation.description: Path of the site Makevars file.
translation.details: The same search. An empty result is an empty string.
translation.value: A path, or an empty string.
translation.example:
import os, tempfile
from tools import makevars_site
path = tempfile.mktemp()
open(path, "w").write("X=1\n")
os.environ["R_MAKEVARS_SITE"] = path
print(makevars_site())
